title: Exclude live destination-bank reuse for P104 owned MOVEs (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** On exact #7277, the required field at each of the 47 paid owned MOVE clocks lies outside the rational span of all other nonzero live rows in that MOVE's original destination chart. The scope exhausts 424 donor incidences and leaves zero unresolved. The compatible whole-word saving upper is exactly zero.

## Task and overlap

Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. #6069 tests live destination spans on an older complex word, #7293 tests the retained BIT word, and #7165 tests older complex donor routes. This package freezes the exact #7277 clocks, owners and destination charts. It complements #7307's zero-input and direct-CLEAR exclusions. Two inherited #7257 commits enable hosted replay.

## Validation

From a clean checkout with CPython 3.12 and assertions enabled:

~~~sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-owned-move-destination-span
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-owned-move-destination-span --check-modes --check-source-history
~~~

The replay saves directed 17-copy prices before support. The optimistic upper is about 1,778.20218 raw units for 44 pair-eligible sites and 1,676.28799 for 39 larger banks before added costs. All 2,767 pairs fail. The complete-bank replay checks 47 sparse separating duals against the actual signed rows. Independent exact integer ranks cover 39 larger banks, and separate exact pair, single and zero checks cover the smaller ones. The engines share the pinned normalized interpreter. Registered, committed modes and source history, six navigation checks, and the Git-free official export passed locally. A corrupted word was rejected.

## Credit

#7277 at ed090b57ed88f8859e5ff4643645099e6ba856ea supplies the native word and the strongest independently reproduced comparable witness at κ = 0.003645669928698. #7113 supplies the signed caller. Credit #6069, #7293, #7165, #7298 and #7307 for the prior span and donor mechanisms, identical retained input blobs, and direct-deletion evidence. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

## Open next questions

Changed clocks, alternative chart IDs, retired cached rows, new paid deliveries and changed ownership remain outside the scope. Each prospective replacement must reproduce the arbitrary-input signed action and carry its complete charges.
